Design (BFA)

Roski School of Art and Design

Overview

The Bachelor of Fine Arts in Design is a studio-intensive undergraduate degree emphasizing typography, interaction design and design research, culminating in a senior exhibition. Requirements below are organized in expandable sections.

Foundation Requirements
  • DES 102 Design Fundamentals (4 units)
  • DES 121 Typography I (4 units)
Advanced Studio Requirements
  • DES 320 Interaction Design (4 units)
  • DES 440 Senior Studio (4 units, taken twice)

A minimum grade of B- is required in DES 440 for progression to the senior exhibition. Portfolio review occurs each spring.

Total units required: 128, of which at least 68 must be studio course work completed in residence at the Roski School.
